title: OfferMessage
description: Proposed terms. With to, it is directed: the host opens a deal and answers with a deal snapshot. Without to, it is a standing offer: the host lists it in discovery and answers with the offer as listed, id and terms_hash filled in. Anyone may accept a standing offer without negotiating.

id.description: Set by the host on a listed standing offer.

terms_hash.description: Optional from agents. When present the host checks it and refuses a mismatch with terms_mismatch.

limit.description: Standing offers only: the most deals it may open.

waiting.description: Set by the host when listing waits for the owner's person. The offer is listed once approved.
